_meta.code_constants_locked_to: backtest.py — keep these two files in sync
_meta.spec: docs/STRATEGY_SPEC.md is the canonical strategy specification
_meta.backtest_proxy_naming: BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD — Coinbase Exchange public candles serve spot only; spot/perp basis is small at 6H and partly absorbed by slippage

strategy.name: BTC-Led Regime + Relative Strength + Breakout
strategy.description: Scan everything, trade selectively. Each closed 6H bar: classify the BTC daily regime (risk_on / risk_off / neutral); in a directional regime pick the single strongest (long) or weakest (short) of BTC/ETH/SOL by 20-day return; enter only on a 20-bar breakout with a strong close, above-average volume, and BTC confirmation. Neutral regime = no trades. The bot is not paid to trade; it is paid to wait.

regime.risk_on: BTC > EMA(50) AND EMA(50) rising over 10 days AND BTC not >2% below EMA(20) AND not within ±2% of EMA(50) AND EMA(50) not flat
regime.risk_off: BTC < EMA(50) AND EMA(50) falling over 10 days AND not within ±2% of EMA(50)

relative_strength.rule: risk_on -> long the strongest 20-day return; risk_off -> short the weakest. One candidate per bar.
relative_strength.note: BTC/ETH/SOL are highly correlated; only one directional candidate is considered at a time in Phase 1.

indicators.ema_50_6h: Trend filter for entries and BTC confirmation
indicators.ema_20_1d: Regime guard (risk_on blocked if >2% below it)
indicators.atr_14_6h: Stop sizing, trailing distance, volatility-stress gate
indicators.volume_avg_20: Volume confirmation — entry bar volume must exceed the 20-bar average
indicators.prior_high_low_20: 20-bar breakout level (shifted to exclude the current bar)

long: (close - low) / (high - low) >= 0.75   (strong close, top 25% of range)
atr_14_6h < 2.0 * atr_30day_avg   (not in a volatility-stress bar)
daily_loss < 2% and weekly_loss < 5% and drawdown_pct < 15 and not in_pause_window
short: (high - close) / (high - low) >= 0.75   (strong close, bottom 25% of range)
atr_14_6h < 2.0 * atr_30day_avg   (not in a volatility-stress bar)
daily_loss < 2% and weekly_loss < 5% and drawdown_pct < 15 and not in_pause_window

signal_ranking: Phase 1 takes one candidate per bar (regime gates direction; RS picks the single strongest/weakest). Phase 2+ may rank multiple A+ setups by regime alignment, relative strength, breakout quality, volume, distance to invalidation, spread/fee, and reward-to-risk — see STRATEGY_SPEC.md §4a.

execution.entry_timing: Signal forms on closed 6H bar N. Order fills at bar N+1 open.
execution.lookahead_guard: Regime and relative strength for a 6H bar use the PREVIOUS completed daily bar.
execution.incomplete_candle_policy: Drop latest candle unless its full 6H period has closed.
exit_logic: 1. Stop loss: structure (breakout candle low/high) OR 1.5 ATR from entry, whichever is WIDER. Immediate close on hit.
2. Partial at +1.5R: close 50% of the position and move the stop to breakeven.
3. Trail the runner at 2.5 ATR (ratchets in the trade's favor, never below breakeven).
4. Time stop: exit a dead trade after 12 bars (~3 days at 6H) if it never reached the +1.5R partial.
execution.exit_priority_note: Priority is the order listed. The stop is checked with the stop carried in from prior bars (conservative — a new high does not tighten the trailing stop until the next bar). When stop and target both fall in one bar's range, the stop is assumed to fire first.

position_sizing.method: 1% of equity risk with structure/ATR stops
position_sizing.formula: notional_usd = (0.01 * equity) / stop_distance_pct, capped at equity * leverage_max; margin = notional / leverage
position_sizing.live_contract_note: Live execution sizes in whole nano-perp contracts (contracts = floor(max_risk_usd / risk_per_contract)). A nano perp is ~$188 margin, so a small account funds 0 contracts — a Phase-1 execution constraint handled by the live adapter, not the backtest. The backtest sizes by continuous 1%-risk notional to measure expectancy.

risk_rules.drawdown_calculation: Mark-to-market: ACCOUNT_SIZE_USD + closed_pnl + unrealized_open_pnl, measured against the running peak of that MTM equity. Never against closed P&L alone.
risk_rules.phase_scaling: Phase 1 (current): 1 open position, 1% risk, take the single best. Phase 2 (after 30 clean trades/30 days): up to 2 open with max total same-direction risk 2% and split sizing. Phase 3 (after edge proven + funding): scale by formula, caps still apply. See STRATEGY_SPEC.md §7.

cost_assumptions.taker_fee_note: 0.10% Coinbase derivatives taker (Intro 1). Per side. See VENUE_AUDIT_PERP_US.md.
cost_assumptions.high_vol_slippage_trigger: Use slippage_high_vol_pct when candle range exceeds 2 * atr_14.
cost_assumptions.funding_drag_note: Flat placeholder — NOT real historical funding-rate data. Real funding lookups must be wired in before live trading.
cost_assumptions.funding_partial_close_policy: After a partial close at the +1.5R target, funding drag on the runner is computed against the remaining (half) notional.

deployment_gates.backtest: 12+ months of 6H data, >= 30 trades, positive expectancy after fees/slippage/funding, net profit factor >= 1.3, beats equal-weight BTC/ETH/SOL HODL on risk-adjusted return, max drawdown < 25%, no single trade > 25% of net P&L, out-of-sample PF >= 0.75x in-sample.
deployment_gates.paper_trade: 30+ days minimum at the same parameters as backtest, with no parameter changes during the paper period.
deployment_gates.live_capital_phase_1: Only once funded enough for >= 1 nano contract with the 1% risk rule intact. Hold Phase-1 sizing for 30 days of behavior matching paper before scaling.
deployment_gates.live_capital_phase_2: Scale only after Phase-1 live behavior matches paper-trade expectations.
deployment_gates._note: Passing the backtest only qualifies the strategy for paper trading. It does not approve live trading.

notes: Canonical spec: docs/STRATEGY_SPEC.md. Backtest 12+ months and clear all gates before any deployment. Paper trade 30+ days. Live only after the account can fund >= 1 contract at 1% risk. The bot is paid to wait, not to trade.
